items.title: 15.5.2 Peripheral Nervous System - Cranial & Spinal Nerves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cranial and spinal nerves (PDF 40-42).

blocks.text: Peripheral nervous system nerves aur ganglia par mushtamil hai. Nerves axons ke taar (cable) jaise majmooe hain. Ganglia CNS ke bahar cell bodies ke guchhe hain. Jo nerves dimagh se nikalti hain unhein cranial nerves kehte hain, aur jo spinal cord se nikalti hain unhein spinal nerves kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hai ke "jo spinal nerves se nikalti hain unhein spinal nerves kehte hain". Sahi yeh hai ke spinal nerves spinal cord se nikalti hain.

Cranial nerves ke 12 jore (pairs) hain. Pehle do jore (olfactory nerve aur optic nerve) kitab ke mutabiq cerebrum se nikalte hain. Baqi 10 jore brainstem se nikalte hain. Kuch cranial nerves sensory hain, kuch motor aur kuch mixed (jin mein sensory aur motor dono neurons ke axons hon).

blocks.alt: Dimagh ka neeche ka hissa aur cranial nerves ke barah jore mukhtalif rangon mein: aagay olfactory bulbs (CN-I), aapas mein guzarti optic nerves (CN-II), aur CN-III se CN-XII tarteeb se brainstem se nikalti, midbrain se medulla tak; neeche cerebellum.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Optic nerve (II) ko aam taur par cerebrum ke bajaye diencephalon se jura bataya jata hai; kitab ise olfactory nerve ke saath cerebrum se nikalne wali ginti hai.
Spinal nerves ke ikattees (31) jore hain. Tamam spinal nerves mixed hain. Yeh spinal cord aur baqi jism ke darmiyan sensory aur motor maloomat le jati hain.

Har spinal nerve spinal cord se do chhoti shakhon ya jaron (roots) ke zariye nikalti hai. Dorsal root (pichli jar) mein sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites hote hain. Ventral root (agli jar) mein motor neurons ke axons hote hain. Dono jarein spinal nerve ke vertebral column se nikalne se zara pehle mil jati hain. Sensory neurons ki cell bodies spinal cord ke bahar dorsal root ganglia mein ikatthi hoti hain. Somatic motor neurons ki cell bodies spinal cord ke andar hoti hain, is liye woh ganglia mein nahin hoteen. Spinal nerves ke 31 jore yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Peeche se dimagh aur spinal cord, aur cord se nikalte spinal nerves ke 31 jore: oopar 8 cervical, phir 12 thoracic (yahan cord naranji, jaise kitab mein), neeche ki taraf 5 lumbar aur 5 sacral jore, aur aakhir mein aik coccygeal jora.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Cervical nerves, Thoracic nerves, Lumbar nerves, Sacral nerves, Coccygeal nerve.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Spinal cord ke saath oopar se neeche ginein: gardan mein 8 cervical, seene mein 12 thoracic, kamar mein 5 lumbar, us ke neeche 5 sacral aur aakhir mein 1 coccygeal jora; kul 8 + 12 + 5 + 5 + 1 = 31 jore.

blocks.prompt: Spinal nerve ki dorsal root mein kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites; un ki cell bodies dorsal root ganglion mein hoti hain.

items: PNS: nerves (axons ke majmooe) aur ganglia (CNS ke bahar cell bodies). Cranial nerves ke 12 jore (sensory, motor ya mixed). Spinal nerves ke 31 jore, sab mixed: dorsal root sensory (ganglion ke saath), ventral root motor; 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 1 coccygeal.
